objects.description: During [Cutting Edge](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0029), threat actors disabled logging and modified the `compcheckresult.cgi` component to edit the Ivanti Connect Secure built-in Integrity Checker exclusion list to evade detection.(Citation: Mandiant Cutting Edge Part 2 January 2024)(Citation: Volexity Ivanti Zero-Day Exploitation January 2024)
objects.description_fa: در طول [Cutting Edge](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0029)، بازیگران تهدید گزارش را غیرفعال کردند و مؤلفه «compcheckresult.cgi» را برای ویرایش فهرست حذف داخلی Ivanti Connect Secure Integrity Checker برای فرار از شناسایی، تغییر دادند. (Citation: Mandiant Cutting Edge Part 2 January 2024) (Citation: Volexity Ivanti Zero-Day Exploitation January 2024)
